description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HighlightedMenuItemHostView' that manages highlighting behavior for menu items in a macOS application, including mouse tracking, drawing highlight background, and integrating with SwiftUI via NSViewRepresentable. It also defines 'MenuHostedHighlightedItem' as a SwiftUI wrapper for the custom view.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: A custom NSView that manages highlight state, mouse tracking, layout, and rendering for a menu item with SwiftUI integration.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the view with a SwiftUI view and a target width, setting up the hosting view and layout.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the root SwiftUI view and width, refreshes highlight state.

methods.name: updateHighlight()
methods.description: Updates the environment to reflect highlight state and triggers UI refresh.

methods.name: updateSizing()
methods.description: Adjusts the frame size of the hosting view based on current width and fitting size.
